headline: Escalating Iran War Triggers Global Energy Crisis and Critical Semiconductor Material Shortage
summary: The intensifying conflict in the Middle East, marked by an Israeli strike on Iran and subsequent retaliatory attacks on Qatari energy infrastructure, has wiped out 17% of Qatar's crucial LNG capacity for up to five years, igniting a severe global energy crisis. This escalation also directly impacts the semiconductor industry by triggering a critical helium shortage, threatening AI infrastructure development and fab operations worldwide.
